# Fieseros

> Fieseros (https://fieseros.com) is an autonomous, AI-powered field service management (FSM) platform and operating system designed for trade businesses, commercial contractors, and home service providers. It combines a 24/7 AI voice receptionist, intelligent GPS route dispatching, automated quoting, invoicing with zero platform commission, and a verified contractor marketplace.

## Key Information
- Platform: Fieseros
- Website: https://fieseros.com
- Headquarters: Wilmington, Delaware, United States
- Operating Hours: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET (Support & Sales); 24/7 Autonomous AI Reception & Dispatch
- Commission Model: 0% platform commission on payments; $0 lead fees for verified contractors
- Core Architecture: Next.js App Router, PostgreSQL / Supabase, PWA (iOS & Android offline-first)
- Primary Supported Industries: HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, Roofing, Pest Control, Landscaping, Cleaning, Auto Repair, General Contracting

## Core Modules & Capabilities
- [AI Voice Receptionist](https://fieseros.com#ai-receptionist): 24/7 inbound AI phone agent that answers calls within 2 rings, qualifies callers, captures emergency service details, and books appointments directly into dispatch calendars.
- [AI Smart Dispatch Board](https://fieseros.com#dispatch): Dynamic dispatch engine matching technician certifications, live GPS coordinates, parts-on-van inventory, and traffic patterns to optimize daily route density.
- [Field Service CRM & Invoicing](https://fieseros.com#invoicing): End-to-end customer management, multi-option tiered quotes (Good/Better/Best), instant tap-to-pay on site, automated review requests, and zero-fee payment processing.
- [GPTForm™ & Chatbot Engine](https://fieseros.com/templates): Over 20,000 synthesized booking forms and conversational AI lead magnets embeddable on contractor websites.
- [Verified Pro Marketplace](https://fieseros.com/marketplace): Directory of verified trade businesses across the US, Canada, UK, and Australia with independent verification badges for Identity, Business, Insurance, and Licensing.

## Public Endpoints & Directories
- [Marketplace Directory](https://fieseros.com/marketplace): Browse verified trade professionals by industry, city, and state/province.
- [Form & Chatbot Templates](https://fieseros.com/templates): Comprehensive library of trade-specific lead intake and booking templates.
- [Contact & Support](https://fieseros.com/contact-us): Sales, technical support, and operating hours (Monday – Friday 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET).
- [Terms of Service](https://fieseros.com/terms): Platform usage and provider service agreements.
- [Privacy Policy](https://fieseros.com/privacy): Data protection, GDPR, and consumer privacy commitments.
